description: This file provides utility functions and macros for managing the Data Watchpoint and Trace (DWT) unit on Cortex-M CPUs, including enabling/disabling the DWT, initializing cycle counters, and handling debug monitor features.

methods.name: dwt_access
methods.description: Enables or disables access to the DWT registers, with special handling for Cortex-M7 to unlock or lock the DWT access based on the Lock Access Register (LAR).

methods.name: z_arm_dwt_init
methods.description: Enables the DWT unit and tracing, preparing it for use.

methods.name: z_arm_dwt_init_cycle_counter
methods.description: Initializes and enables the DWT cycle counter, resetting its value to zero.

methods.name: z_arm_dwt_get_cycles
methods.description: Returns the current value of the DWT cycle counter.

methods.name: z_arm_dwt_cycle_count_start
methods.description: Resets and starts the DWT cycle counter.

methods.name: z_arm_dwt_enable_debug_monitor
methods.description: Enables the debug monitor handler and sets its priority, with assertions to ensure the CPU is in a proper state.
